entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to make a return.
I can certainly help you with that. To pull up your account, could I get your name and order number, please?
Jane Doe, order number VF88602. I need to return the VeloBand GPS Tracker. Just process it and send me the label.
Okay, Jane, I have your order right here. I see it was delivered on December 15th. Before I proceed, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the band?
It's just not what I wanted. I don't need troubleshooting or a long discussion, just the return label. Can you do it, yes or no?

I understand you're looking for a quick answer. With wearable devices, I do have to check the dates carefully. Our return policy can be strict for hygiene and sanitation reasons, as we can't resell items that have been worn.
So is it too late? I've had it less than a month.

Let me confirm the specific policy for your item right now... one moment... Ah, okay, my mistake. The stricter rules apply to a different device. For your VeloBand GPS Tracker, our standard 90-day return policy is in effect. You are well within that window.
Good. So you're sending the label?

Yes, absolutely. I've just processed the return authorization. You'll receive an email with the prepaid shipping label and instructions within the next five minutes. Once we receive the item, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method.
Okay, fine. That's all I needed.
Perfect. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Jane?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
